sources.title: Visas to Jordan
sources.officialityEvidence: Jordan's live official tourism-board nationality table directly maps Israel to a visa obtained on arrival.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Israel | Applicable | Visa can be obtained upon arrival, it will cost a total of 40 JOD.

sources.title: Entry into the Maldives is prohibited on Israeli passports

sources.supportingExcerpt: entry into the Maldives on Israeli passports is prohibited effective from 15th April 2025

policies.title: Israeli ordinary passports: Jordan visitor visa on arrival
policies.summary: Jordan's official nationality table says Israeli visitors can obtain a visa on arrival.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Israeli passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
Jordan's page instructs non-Jordanian visitors to register through Gateway2Jordan before departure and present the resulting QR code.
Restricted crossings, non-visitor purposes and final admission remain outside scope.
